notes: First edition in which BNEF lowered both short- and long-term global EV forecasts (US policy changes). 2040 share fell from 73% (EVO 2024) to 70%. Price parity: the release says China is the only country where EVs are on average cheaper to buy than comparable ICE vehicles (a status statement, not a forecast year). No global 2030 figure in the public release.
